title: A Single Cloud Can Weigh Over a Million Pounds
description: That fluffy cloud floating above you holds an astonishing amount of water. Here is how it stays up.

scenes.text: That soft little cloud floating above you could weigh more than a million pounds.
scenes.subject: cloud
scenes.say: [whispers] That soft little cloud floating above you... [excited] could weigh more than a MILLION pounds.

scenes.text: Clouds are made of countless tiny water droplets. A typical puffy cloud can hold around five hundred tons of water.
scenes.subject: cloud
scenes.say: Clouds are made of countless tiny water droplets. A typical puffy cloud can hold around five hundred tons of water.

scenes.text: So why doesn't it crash down? Because that weight is spread across a huge space, and each droplet is incredibly small.
scenes.subject: cloud
scenes.say: [curious] So why doesn't it crash down? Because that weight is spread across a huge space, and each droplet is incredibly small.

scenes.text: The droplets are so light that rising warm air keeps them floating, until they join together and fall as rain.
scenes.subject: cloud
scenes.say: The droplets are so light that rising warm air keeps them floating, until they join together and fall as rain.

scenes.text: So the next time you look up, remember there are elephants worth of water up there. Follow for more weird facts.
